mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_requirement_detail (run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, source_month, parent_material_code, current_material_code, level_no, path_text, path_hash, category_role, supply_mode, explosion_policy, effective_explosion_policy, policy_source, gross_qty, inventory_before_qty, inventory_used_qty, inventory_after_qty, net_qty, terminal_flag, terminal_reason) VALUES (#{runId}, #{batchId}, #{factoryCode}, #{rootMaterialCode}, #{sourceMonth}, #{parentMaterialCode}, #{currentMaterialCode}, #{levelNo}, #{pathText}, #{pathHash}, #{categoryRole}, #{supplyMode}, #{explosionPolicy}, #{effectiveExplosionPolicy}, #{policySource}, #{grossQty}, #{inventoryBeforeQty}, #{inventoryUsedQty}, #{inventoryAfterQty}, #{netQty}, #{terminalFlag}, #{terminalReason})

INSERT INTO mrp_requirement_detail (run_id, batch_id, factory_code, root_material_code, source_month, parent_material_code, current_material_code, level_no, path_text, path_hash, category_role, supply_mode, explosion_policy, effective_explosion_policy, policy_source, gross_qty, inventory_before_qty, inventory_used_qty, inventory_after_qty, net_qty, terminal_flag, terminal_reason) VALUES
(#{item.runId}, #{item.batchId}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.rootMaterialCode}, #{item.sourceMonth}, #{item.parentMaterialCode}, #{item.currentMaterialCode}, #{item.levelNo}, #{item.pathText}, #{item.pathHash}, #{item.categoryRole}, #{item.supplyMode}, #{item.explosionPolicy}, #{item.effectiveExplosionPolicy}, #{item.policySource}, #{item.grossQty}, #{item.inventoryBeforeQty}, #{item.inventoryUsedQty}, #{item.inventoryAfterQty}, #{item.netQty}, #{item.terminalFlag}, #{item.terminalReason})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_requirement_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY factory_code, root_material_code, source_month, level_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_requirement_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT * FROM mrp_requirement_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND root_material_code=#{rootMaterialCode} ORDER BY source_month, level_no
SELECT * FROM mrp_requirement_detail WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY root_material_code, source_month, level_no
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mrp_requirement_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND level_no > 0
